findings.title: Let native Other notes be corrected after rejection
findings.body: A native accept of Other with empty or omitted notes passes Interaction::values, which only calls validate_form_values and treats qN_notes as optional. Commit then fails in grok::response at src/acp/grok.rs:160-164 with invalid-request and, as the unit case shows, leaves the question pending with an empty output queue. The editor has already set captured in src/tui/agent.rs:1721-1723. The daemon error arrives asynchronously; src/tui/control.rs:423-429 records the code and does not call restore_unqueued. editable at src/tui/agent.rs:1294-1296 then refuses F5, F7, and draft edits, so that attachment cannot supply the required notes or cancel the retained question. Ctrl-C can still interrupt the prompt, and a new API call can answer it. Impact is a stuck native correction path for a supported Grok answer, not a second wire response or a consumed responder.
findings.consumer: src/tui/agent.rs:1648 values(); src/tui/agent.rs:1721 capture(); src/tui/agent.rs:1294 editable(); src/tui/control.rs:423 poll error
findings.suggestion: Before capture, reject Other unless the sibling field named by _meta.grok_notes_key is non-empty, using the same rule as grok::response, and do not set captured. Alternatively, if an acp-answer error returns while that interaction is still pending with a null selected_work_id, clear captured so a deliberate corrected answer can be sent.

checklist.evidence: src/acp.rs:2012-2016 dispatches _x.ai/ask_user_question through grok::form then parse_form. elicitation/create remains a separate arm. No prose or MCP question parser was added.
grok::form schema_keys rejects unknown request, question, and option fields. Count is capped at FIELDS/2 and total choices at OPTIONS before parse_form publication. Invented mode is rejected.

Null or absent multiSelect/multi_select becomes single string oneOf. Both flags together are rejected. Explicit true becomes a minItems 1 array. Unit case e04s04_grok_nullable_multiselect covers null.

Labels, descriptions, and non-null string previews are preserved. Other is added when absent. Accepted answers are label arrays keyed by question text; a single selected preview and non-empty notes become annotations. Empty annotations are omitted.

Duplicate question text and per-question option labels are rejected before an interaction is published. Optional question/option ids are shape-checked and are not answer keys; the published Grok response tests key answers by question text, so unused duplicate ids have no selection effect.
parse_form requires the live session and a valid toolCallId. The JSON-RPC id is stored as wire_id and returned on accept, cancel, and invalid-params. A mismatched session publishes no interaction.

Accept uses outcome accepted. Cancel and interrupt use outcome cancelled, including late questions. Decline bails before encode. Upstream AskUserQuestionExtResponse accepts label vectors and omits empty annotations; this matches that contract.

mode plan is accepted as a question, not as decline or cancel. actions are only accept and cancel. No chat_about_this or skip_interview outcome is synthesized. README and the form message state that limitation.
Grok answers use pending_interaction and the existing prepare/commit winner. The losing call is stale-interaction, is absent from calls, and does not add a second output frame.
API decline returns unsupported before enqueue. The unit case keeps output and work empty, state pending, and the call id unrecorded. Native F6 returns None when actions omit decline.

The production delta does not call interrupt, kill, or session/cancel from force. Live question_force checks the original work tuple and pending question after ownership-claim mode force. Unchanged control.rs force remains authority-only.

Commit checks the admitted generation. The live row rejects a stale API answer with stale-control or stale-handle and fences a physical F5 from the lost owner before the current answer. Binding changes discard drafts rather than rebinding them.

Question and force completion require the original prompt and, unless the permission row is an explicit reject_once, end_turn. reject_once may finish cancelled. The observer counts session/cancel separately, and the recorded final matrix has cancellations 0.

Interaction::cancel_frame emits outcome cancelled for grok_question. The interrupt arm cancels pending session-scoped questions and sends session/cancel only for that explicit interrupt, not for force.
A question arriving while foreground is cancelling is selected and responded before publication. The unit case checks both the pending and late RPC ids.
No new claim-cancel path was added. Unchanged control admission still grants nobody on ordinary pending cancellation and does not discard accepted calls. This patch does not reopen that contract.
daemon acp_action still authorizes, prepares, then admit_acp, which checks the current generation under the target lock before commit. grok::response performs no I/O and takes no second lock.

Invalid Grok requests become invalid-params on the original RPC and do not push an interaction. Valid questions pass retain_capacity before responder publication. Frame and queue caps are the existing ones.
The new codec is pure JSON. Commit still does not spawn, join, or probe under the state lock. The test observer is outside the daemon lock order.
Decline and Other-without-notes return before enqueue and do not record the call. Close, pipe ownership, and worker joins are outside this delta and were not rewritten.

The ignored driver checks termios restoration, controlling-PTY exit 0, drainer join, canonical close, daemon exit 0, socket and root absence, and sentinel survival before Host fallback. Parent artifact 1659 is cited, not re-executed.
decline_offered is false when an actions array exists and lacks decline. Grok sets [accept, cancel]. Absent actions still offer decline for standard elicitation. F6 sends nothing for Grok.
F5 still reviews then accepts. F7 sends cancel, which grok::response encodes as outcome cancelled. The footer and review line say decline is not offered.

Broker retention is correct, but native local validation does not know the Other-notes rule. After the async invalid-request, captured stays set and the same attachment cannot correct or cancel the retained question. This is the should-fix.
Question text, descriptions, previews, and notes reach the host through display_value/inert and ratatui Paragraph/Line cells, not a raw terminal write. Control and bidi characters are replaced.

Current tests cover nullable single choice, single and multi answers, preview, Other notes, decline retention, wrong session, duplicate text/labels, bad mode, count, first-valid, and explicit/late cancel. They assert wire and state, not source text.

e04s04_live_adapters is ignored unless explicitly selected and fail-closes without a private absolute config. It requires Codex and Grok, four named rows, original end_turn except explicit reject_once cancelled, and zero session/cancel. The observer forwards the original chunk, not reserialized JSON.

The live test is not treated as a zero-case pass. README still calls terminal settlement best-effort. BUG-e03-native-settlement.md is in the frozen manifest and was not rewritten by this review. Historical caps are not reset here.

Default metadata omits question text. The observer stores field types, model, effort, and counts, not prompts or answers. It refuses API-key environments. Production gained no shell interpolation; the live effect command is test-only, quote-checked, and confined to the private cwd.
Permission encoding is unchanged. The live allow/deny rows select the exact offered allow_once or reject_once id and check the approved file bytes or absence. No allow option is fabricated.
src/acp/grok.rs is a private closed codec into the existing form ledger and responder. Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock match the frozen manifest. No second agent or compatibility proxy was added.

Runtime state stays in memory. IDs and errors remain explicit. The codec is one module rather than a plugin seam. README and CHANGELOG match accept/cancel, nullable single choice, and the unresolved fence. No actionable Fowler smell was introduced.

explanation:
One should-fix, zero must-fix. Score 100*(32-0-1)/32=96.875. This is not story acceptance and does not reset historical caps. Grok _x.ai/ask_user_question is a closed projection into the existing form, responder, admission, and cancel path. Nullable multiSelect is single choice; duplicate question text and option labels are rejected; accept/cancel keep the original RPC; unsupported decline sends nothing. Force is not wired to interrupt or kill. The defect is native recovery: Other without notes fails only in grok::response after the editor has captured the action, and the async invalid-request does not clear that capture, so the same attachment cannot correct the still-pending question. checks_run=false. Independent hashlib.sha256 matched 22/22 manifest files. Limitations: no build, test, clippy, formatter, provider, auth, or second hash algorithm; round4 reviewer B and security reports were not read.
